periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation angled downward towards the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical oval morphology with a height-to-width ratio greater than 1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering where the patch narrows significantly at its lowest visible point.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Flat U-shape with a relatively straight posterior margin across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High lateral thickness extending approximately one-third the length of the visible torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation distance approximately equal to the width of the cranial vault between the pinnae.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semicircular profile with no visible irregularities.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-yellow chromophore saturation in the white fur across the posterior dorsal and flank regions.
